title: Towards Tracing Trustworthiness Dynamics: Revisiting Pre-training Period of Large Language Models
findings: The paper found that representations of fairness concepts, which include religious stereotypes, are linearly separable in the model's middle layers even during early pre-training. Furthermore, it demonstrated that 'steering vectors' extracted from these pre-training checkpoints can be used to intervene in a fine-tuned model to enhance its fairness performance (measured by StereoSet) and reduce stereotypical biases.
